notes: אִתָּנוּ is the verbless clause's predicate, so the supplied 'shall remain' frame joins the preposition and heads on 'with' (rule 49). The competing reading, marking the italicized frame added under rule 20, is named in the unit note.
אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן takes its supplied 'into' and 'the' as an adverbial accusative of direction (rules 33, 15), and מֵעֵבֶר fuses to 'beyond' while the following לְ keeps nothing (rules 30, 40).
